title: Dominic & Junior
author: Dominic Chianese
description: Welcome to the official channel of Dominic Chianese. For more than seven decades, Dominic has dedicated his life to acting, music, and storytelling. Best known for his unforgettable performances in The Sopranos and The Godfather Part II, his greatest passion has always been connecting with people through the arts. Here you'll find conversations, performances, behind-the-scenes moments, reflections on a lifetime in the craft, and stories about family, faith, resilience, and the people who inspire us.
